feedback: Based on prior experience with similar 5-sensor arrays, the controller compensates for moderate sensor spacing by weighting outer sensors more strongly to correct larger deviations. If the next race shows frequent line loss events, consider increasing sensor size or adding sensors closer to the edges to improve line detection. If the robot shows high rms_error or max_error, try adjusting the wheel track or body width to improve stability and turning precision. If progress is low but line loss is minimal, consider tuning PID gains or increasing base speed for better forward motion.
requested_changes: sensor_size: 0.016 to increase sensor coverage and reduce line loss, based on evidence that larger sensors reduce line loss events in similar geometries.
wheel_track: 0.16 to improve turning stability and reduce max_error, supported by prior races showing tighter wheel tracks increase off-track risk.
body_width: 0.16 to allow a wider off-track margin and improve stability, as wider bodies tolerate more lateral error before ending the run.
